
```{r}
# NA count
```

Since categories, geners, and tags have multiple types, split and check types, freq
```{r}
#View(df)
categories <- strsplit(na.omit(df_merged$Categories), ",")
genres <- strsplit(na.omit(df_merged$Genres), ",")
tags <- strsplit(na.omit(df_merged$Tags), ",")
```

```{r}
categories <- trimws(unlist(categories))
genres <- trimws(unlist(genres))
tags <- trimws(unlist(tags))

# Remove empty
categories <- categories[categories != ""]
genres <- genres[genres != ""]
tags <- tags[tags != ""]

# Unique count
length(unique(categories))
length(unique(genres))
length(unique(tags))
```

```{r}
category_counts <- sort(table(categories), decreasing = TRUE)
genre_counts <- sort(table(genres), decreasing = TRUE)
tag_counts <- sort(table(tags), decreasing = TRUE)
```

```{r}
head(category_counts, 20)
head(genre_counts, 20)
head(tag_counts, 20)
```

```{r}
barplot(
  category_counts,
  main = "Top 20 Categories"
)
```

```{r}
barplot(
  genre_counts,
  main = "Top 20 Genres"
)
```

```{r}
barplot(
  tag_counts,
  main = "Top 20 Tags"
)
```


```{r}
summary(as.numeric(category_counts))
summary(as.numeric(genre_counts))
summary(as.numeric(tag_counts))
```



```{r}
total_sample = nrow(df)
category_ratio <- category_counts / total_sample
genre_ratio <- genre_counts / total_sample
tag_ratio <- tag_counts / total_sample
```

set threshold 5%
10% for tag as
```{r}
threshold <- 0.05
threshold_tag <- 0.1

selected_categories <- names(category_ratio[category_ratio >= threshold])
selected_genres <- names(genre_ratio[genre_ratio >= threshold])
selected_tags <- names(tag_ratio[tag_ratio >= threshold])
```

```{r}
length(selected_categories)
length(selected_genres)
length(selected_tags)
```
